varietyReview: Polynomial accumulation slope, squared-upper-limit cosine chain, variable-lower radical, zero base value versus nonzero local slope, actual continuous-function table lookup, affine-upper logarithm chain, continuous nondifferentiable absolute-value integrand, sine lower limit with exponential, negative-input squared endpoint, additive initial constant and a discontinuous-integrand corner counterexample.
